design.name: 👁️ Show Actions
design.note: Overarching container toggle for Actions 1 and Actions 2, design-only. In code the visibility follows from whether the actions1 / actions2 slots are filled.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Set max width for the component

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Set the expanded/collapsed state initially for the left sidebar

properties.name: brandInstance
properties.description: Slot to pass in the DBControlPanelBrand component

design.name: 🔄 CP Brand
design.note: Separate property instance per component set; keys differ (#38590:4 on top and #38759:4 on drill-down-left and tree-left).

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Change the orientation. Defaults to horizontal.

properties.name: meta
properties.description:
Slot to pass in a meta navigation.
Desktop: Above the regular control-panel-desktop
Mobile: Inside the drawer

properties.name: actions1
properties.description:
Slot to pass one or more elements like DBButton (e.g. search) as actions-1.
Desktop: Shown next to the main-navigation
Mobile: Shown next to the control-panel-brand

properties.name: actions2
properties.description:
Slot to pass one or more elements like DBButton (e.g. profile, language, etc.) as actions-2.
Desktop: Shown separated by divider at the end of the control-panel-desktop
Mobile: Shown inside the drawer at the bottom.

properties.name: skipNavigation
properties.description: Slot to pass an anchor or link to skip the navigation and jump to main content.

properties.name: expandButtonTooltip
properties.description: Set the tooltip for the expand/collapse button

properties.name: expandButtonTooltipFn
properties.description: Set the tooltip for the expand/collapse button based on the state. (only react|vue)

properties.name: onExpandButtonTooltipFn
properties.description: Set the tooltip for the expand/collapse button based on the state. (only react|vue)
